name: Practice Better
short_description: All-in-one practice management for health and wellness professionals including nutritionists, dietitians, health coaches, and naturopaths.
long_description: Practice Better is an all-in-one EHR and practice management platform built specifically for health and wellness professionals. Founded in 2014 in Toronto, Canada by holistic nutritionist Nathalie Garcia and Graeme Downes, the platform now serves over 50,000 practitioners across 40+ countries. Practice Better supports dietitians, nutritionists, naturopathic doctors, health coaches, and functional medicine practitioners with client scheduling, appointment management, booking and invoicing, fillable forms, tasks and reminders, health records management, telehealth, secure messaging, and program/group management. The platform is known for its focus on wellness-specific workflows including supplement protocols, food journals, and client engagement programs. Practice Better acquired That Clean Life (meal planning software) to expand its nutrition-focused capabilities.
one_liner: The practice management platform built by wellness professionals, for wellness professionals.
best_for: Solo nutritionists and dietitians managing virtual practices
Health coaches offering programs and group coaching
Small wellness teams needing client management
not_for: Mental health practices requiring clinical EHR features

pricing.notes: Five tiers: Sprout (Free, up to 3 clients), Starter ($35/mo or $25/mo annual, up to 10 clients), Professional ($69/mo, up to 300 clients with PDF branding and Zapier), Plus ($99/mo, unlimited clients, full branding, 750 SMS/month), Team ($155/mo for 2+ practitioners, $50/mo each additional). Price increase July 2025.

integrations.name: Zapier
integrations.notes: Available on Professional plan and above

faqs.q: How much does Practice Better cost?
faqs.a: Practice Better offers five tiers: Sprout (Free, 3 clients), Starter ($35/mo, 10 clients), Professional ($69/mo, 300 clients), Plus ($99/mo, unlimited), and Team ($155/mo for 2+ practitioners). Annual billing saves money.

faqs.q: Is Practice Better good for therapists?
faqs.a: Practice Better is primarily designed for wellness professionals like nutritionists, dietitians, and health coaches. Mental health therapists may find it lacks clinical documentation features found in mental health-specific EHRs like SimplePractice or TherapyNotes.

faqs.q: Does Practice Better offer meal planning?
faqs.a: Practice Better acquired That Clean Life for meal planning capabilities. However, meal planning may require an additional subscription ($30-60/month) depending on your needs.
Yes, Practice Better is HIPAA compliant and provides a Business Associate Agreement (BAA). It's also GDPR compliant for international practitioners.
